adopted_rules: scene ~70% on top, solid info band below
three columns: label / big value + unit / converted line
one short line above the columns
product in a real garage context, own silhouette kept
excluded_elements: using the scene as size calibration

tokens.palette_note: accent is a demo token chosen to echo the demo product; brand accent must come from the job (brand_input_required)

adaptation_rules: default mode 'overlay' (square and 4:5): full-bleed scene, top headline (eyebrow + h1) on a top scrim, bottom scrim, spec chips (icon cell + value + 24px label) at y = H-72-h, gap 24
headline on by default: T04_headline overrides job.headline; T04_headline:false or show_headline:false turns it off; stock lines (Key figures / 核心参数 ...) are kept but logged in notes
headline fit: h1 88 -> compact 72 -> x0.86 until en <= 2 lines; zh breaks only at the author's \n (one line otherwise); width W-2m

product placement: the product box (scene_product un-widened by its 15% slack, half the slack kept under the base; without it a guess of 0.42x0.56 of the picture centred on focus) is fitted into the free band between headline+60 (hl_gap) and chip top-40 (chip_gap); never below cover scale
when the product cannot rise far enough at cover scale, the picture may stop short of the canvas bottom by up to the chip zone; it then fades into the dark ground (.t4fade) under the chips
the frame keeps >= 95% of the slack box (QA scene_product_cropped): zoom and x/y are clamped so the whole scene_product box stays in the frame
chips: one row of equal cells spanning m..W-m whatever the count or language (chip_stretch caps the stretch and centres the row); compact step 100/48; then wrap into rows stacked upward

band mode (all-numeric specs only): tagline (or headline) leads the band above the stats, single line, else dropped; label 42 / number 128 / unit 48 columns with 2px accent dividers; the crop ends >= band_gap (48) below the product base

glass mode: tinted panel (accent shaded 45% at glass_alpha .88, blur 18, top highlight) flush to the canvas edge away from the product; height dimension line (3px cream, 32px end ticks, dashed extension lines) beside the product when dim_box (tight outline) is given and a spec is a length with a height label; leader + square node from that row; dropped in both languages when it has no room (e.g. 4:5)
zh: Latin digits keep Barlow Condensed (font stack --f-cond, --f-cjk); Han in Noto Sans SC; no uppercase; units keep their case
T04_face 'cond' (optional) sets the headline/tagline in Barlow Condensed 800 (104/88) so one display family carries the page
stack / side (legacy): use the same product fit (guess box when scene_product is missing)
limitations: demo_only: all photos are third-party reference images with unverified rights; original branding kept, not replaced
all copy is neutral visual description, not approved product claims
elements above are the measured layout of the main render; real layout is computed by the template rules for each job
